description: This source file defines the S3OutpostsClient class in the Aws\S3Outposts namespace, which is used to interact with the Amazon S3 on Outposts service. It includes method annotations for various client operations such as creating, deleting, and listing endpoints and outposts.

classes.name: S3OutpostsClient
classes.description: A client class for interacting with the Amazon S3 on Outposts service, extending the generic AwsClient.
